en: A colored panoramic postcard view across a harbor toward the historic peninsula of Constantinople (Istanbul). The foreground shows ships and boats on the water of the Golden Horn, with dense urban buildings on both shores. In the distance are prominent domed mosques with tall minarets and other major landmarks of the old city skyline. The image has a printed caption in French at the top and a card number and city name on the left.
